sentences.text: The evidence does not show any car-loan foreclosure charge, so the foreclosure charge on car loans cannot be determined from the documents provided.
The in-force charge clauses shown are for a home loan and state a pre-payment charge of 2% of principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure, while a copy of the same home-loan clause states 3%.
The RBI directions cited here address term loans and pre-payment charges generally, but the findings do not establish that they answer the car-loan question on this record.

missing.searched: Searched the in-force bank policy, loan agreement, and RBI direction excerpts for any car-loan foreclosure or pre-payment charge; only home-loan clauses and general term-loan directions were found.
